name: wal_keep_size
description: Minimum size of WAL files retained in pg_wal to support streaming replication to standby servers.
symptoms: Replication failure due to missing WAL segments
Increased network traffic from WAL re-fetching
tuning_tips: Set based on peak WAL generation rate and maximum expected standby downtime; monitor pg_stat_replication and pg_wal_lsn_diff to avoid gaps.
